changes_this_cycle: Expanded the non-Mundarica web-discovery layer from 14 to 20 verified source leads without extracting unsupported cultural claims.

Added official Ministry of Tribal Affairs / TRI repository records for the 1993 Munda monograph and 2016 Mundari handbook, preserving author/editor, date, pagination, institutional and rights uncertainty metadata.

Added the 2018 Odia–Munda Sabdakosh from the Odisha Special Development Council with compiler and publication metadata verified from the PDF title page; lexical contents remain unextracted until page/entry-level evidence registration.

Added three Bibliothèque nationale de France historical Mundari audio catalogue records: A kahani, Mundari songs, and Durang Kahani / tuila accompaniment, with 1914 recording context preserved and audio reuse rights left unresolved at item level.
Synchronized external discovery into the Streamlit research portal: Universal Search now searches the web-discovery layer, and MMSC has a separate External source discovery tab and live lead count.
Kept external source leads visually and semantically separated from MLHKP canonical sources and cultural evidence so discovery metadata cannot silently become a factual claim.

Extended automated tests to require unique 20-record discovery IDs/URLs, TRI/government rights boundaries, archival-audio contextualization, non-universalization, and Streamlit synchronization of the external-discovery layer.
